title: Duplicate Payment Guard
summary: Tells a double tap, a retry after a timeout and a deliberate repeat payment apart, so the same payee isn't paid twice by accident.
description: Swallows a double tap (charged once), after a timeout offers Check status before paying again because the first may still land, and for a deliberate repeat says "You paid Ravi ₹2,400 12 min ago" and needs a separate second press.
catches: Double taps on the pay button
Retries after a timeout while the first payment may still complete
Repeat payments to the same payee and amount within a window
limits: A disabled or held button reduces accidental repeats; it does not guarantee a payment happens once
Recent payments come from your `payments` prop; payments made elsewhere are unseen
Status checks depend on your onCheckStatus
a11y: The pay button stays focusable (aria-disabled), sets aria-busy while paying and is described by the hint
Escape disarms a second-press state; held Enter repeats are ignored
Focus returns to the button after each phase
server: Use idempotency keys and a unique constraint per payment intent on the server; that is what stops a double charge.
